label: Bible Study
prompt: Train up a _____ in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
verse: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
note: The parenting verse taped to a million refrigerators.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an _____ love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
verse: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
note: 'Lovingkindness' is one word in the KJV — apparently love and kindness refused to be separated.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Therefore Eli said unto Samuel, Go, lie down: and it shall be, if he call thee, that thou shalt say, Speak, LORD; for thy servant _____. So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
verse: Therefore Eli said unto Samuel, Go, lie down: and it shall be, if he call thee, that thou shalt say, Speak, LORD; for thy servant heareth. So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
note: Eli's coaching for young Samuel: 'thy servant heareth' — old-fashioned spelling, timeless posture.

label: Deep Water
prompt: A word fitly spoken is like _____ of gold in pictures of silver.
verse: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
note: The right word at the right moment is jewelry — 'pictures' here means settings of silver.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness _____ it not.
verse: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
note: Where modern versions say 'overcome,' the KJV says the darkness 'comprehended it not.'
